definitions.gloss: model, type, make (of a machine or device)
definitions.explanation: A specific model or type of machine, device, or equipment. Most commonly used for electronics such as smartphones, computers, and cameras, as well as aircraft types.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{機種|きしゅ}に{変|か}えたい。
examples.english: I want to switch to a new model.

examples.japanese: この{機種|きしゅ}はもう{生産|せいさん}{終了|しゅうりょう}している。
examples.english: This model has already been discontinued.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンの{機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}をする{際|さい}は、データの{移行|いこう}を{忘|わす}れないように。
examples.english: When switching smartphone models, don't forget to transfer your data.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in technology and consumer electronics contexts. The compound {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう} (changing to a new device model, abbreviated as {機種|きしゅ}{変|へん}) is especially frequent for smartphone upgrades. Also used for aircraft types in aviation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}: changing device model (especially phones)
- {対応|たいおう}{機種|きしゅ}: compatible/supported models
- {最新|さいしん}{機種|きしゅ}: latest model
- {人気|にんき}{機種|きしゅ}: popular model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {型番|かたばん}: model number (more specific, refers to the alphanumeric designation)
- {機器|きき}: device, equipment (the device itself, not the model type)
